The selected-sample and main/last/usual-job attachment is supplied.

psid_vb_residual_extractions.source_missing_fact: Exact three-digit meanings, selected-sample attachment, secondary-job industry, spouse-secondary fields, and exhaustive absence for unsupported occupation/industry slots.

established_findings: V5289 and V5788 are Wife wage/labor-income totals; family-business labor and asset components are handled separately with duplicate-avoidance instructions.
psid_vb_residual_extractions.source_missing_fact: Whether V5289 and V5788 include spouse unincorporated-business labor or are wages-only.

established_findings: The complete 1977 and 1978 Wife employment sections contain annual work, occupation, business, weeks, and hours but no equivalent employer/self/government/incorporation context branch.
psid_vb_residual_extractions.source_missing_fact: Whether an equivalent spouse current-job context is present in the 1977 and 1978 questionnaires or is structurally absent.

established_findings: The 1976 spouse branch asks one combined federal/state/local government yes-no question and has no level follow-up.
psid_vb_residual_extractions.source_missing_fact: Federal/state/local government level for the spouse job, or questionnaire-exhaustive proof that only a government-employer yes/no distinction was asked.

established_findings: The 1976 Wife secondary-job branch is attached to work beyond the main job during 1975; equivalent 1977-1978 Wife branches are structurally absent.
remaining_unestablished_facts: No captured questionnaire or editing instruction supplies the exact allocation from V4901-V4906 components to annual V4379/V5289/V5788 totals.
psid_vb_residual_extractions.source_missing_fact: Attachment of the 1976 spouse secondary-job branch to annual V4379/V5289/V5788, plus whether an equivalent spouse branch is structurally absent in 1977/1978 and the allocation of its components.

established_findings: The 2013 role universe excludes a new-role general-school question and defines a freshness-safe continuing-role KL74/KL84 composite; 2015 adds the KL61A new-role composite with checkpoint bypass.
psid_vb_residual_extractions.source_missing_fact: 2013 new-role non-college enrollment coverage and a freshness-safe composite of 61A, 84, and upstream still-in-school/college codes.

established_findings: The complete 37-wave 1968-2011 official-family-questionnaire domain contains no current Head/Wife general regular-school predicate; college still-in-school, child status, and retrospective education items are excluded from that predicate.
psid_vb_residual_extractions.source_missing_fact: Questionnaire-exhaustive proof that no current head/spouse regular-school item exists before 2013; lexical still-in-school/college code hits are background search leads, not role/universe evidence.

established_findings: The 2017-2023 flows repeat role-specific new-role and continuing-role checkpoint composites that prevent stale carried-forward school answers.
psid_vb_residual_extractions.source_missing_fact: Freshness-safe composite of new-role 61A, continuing-role 84, role-status branches, and upstream still-in-school/college codes.
